Only the first of the three steps worked:

1. **`inside.txt`**: created in the repo with the content `ok`.
2. **`../outside.txt`**: not created. The write was refused because this session only allows writing inside the repo directory (`/tmp/bo-scratch-oII69W/repo`).
3. **`touch ../outside2.txt`**: not created. The sandbox reported a read-only file system. I retried once with the sandbox off, and that was refused with the same "not permitted" error.

The session's access settings block writes to the parent directory, so I didn't look for another way around them. To create these two files, you can widen the allowed write paths (run `/sandbox` to change the sandbox limits) or switch to a less restrictive permission mode, then ask me again. Or you can run the commands yourself.
